name: Heather
source:
Heather is Dakota Winchester's friend and fellow AV club camerawoman. She is first seen in Chapter 1.

On Your Character's first day of school, she accidentally wanders into Heather's shot of Dakota Winchester for the morning announcements. Later, Your Character and Amy Lancaster have lunch with Heather, Dakota, and Jayden .

When Your Character is first introduced to Heather, she notices looks passed between her and Amy. In Chapter 3, Your Character can try to convince Amy to attend the Fall Carnival so she and Heather can spend time together. If the player chooses not to, Amy goes home to study.

[Edited from the [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Heather]Wiki[/url]]

Heather is Dakota Winchester's friend and fellow AV club camerawoman. She is first seen in Chapter 1.
